10-Day Egypt Heritage Explorer: Cairo to Luxor
summary:
The 10-Day Egypt Itinerary adds Alexandria to a Cairo and Nile journey, bringing Egypt’s Mediterranean history into the route before you travel south. Begin with the Pyramids of Giza, then visit Alexandria before flying to Luxor for Karnak Temple and the Valley of the Kings. From Luxor, spend four nights cruising the Nile toward Aswan, stopping at Edfu and Kom Ombo to explore the temples along the river.
Departure dates can be planned year-round. The journey covers selected 5-star hotels, a 4-night Nile cruise, breakfast, domestic flights, English-speaking local guides, transfers and the sightseeing scheduled in the program.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cairo
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Cairo International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel in Cairo.
Hotel check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Pyramids, Memphis & Saqqara
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit Memphis, the ancient capital of Egypt, and see the colossal statue of Ramesses II. Continue to Saqqara to visit the famous Step Pyramid of Djoser. Later, explore the Pyramids of Giza built for Cheops, Chephren, and Mycerinus, along with the mysterious Great Sphinx of Giza. Transfer back to the hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Flight to Aswan & Leisure Day
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Transfer to Cairo International Airport for your flight to Aswan.
Upon arrival, meet and transfer to your hotel. Free time at leisure. Overnight in Aswan.
Optional excursion: Full-day tour to the magnificent Abu Simbel Temples available at extra cost.

itinerary.title: Aswan & Nile Cruise
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel and check out. Transfer to board your 3-night Nile River cruise with embarkation before lunch. Visit the impressive Aswan High Dam followed by the beautiful Philae Temple located on Agilkia Island. Overnight on board the Nile cruise.

itinerary.title: Kom Ombo & Edfu Temples
itinerary.text: Sail to Kom Ombo and visit the Temple of Kom Ombo dedicated to Sobek and Haroeris. Continue sailing to Edfu and explore the Temple of Edfu, one of the best-preserved temples in Egypt. Overnight on board the Nile cruise.

itinerary.title: Luxor West Bank
itinerary.text: Sail to Esna and continue to Luxor. Cross to the West Bank of the Nile River to visit the famous Valley of the Kings and Valley of the Queens. Explore the impressive Mortuary Temple of Hatshepsut and stop at the Colossi of Memnon. Overnight on board the Nile cruise.

itinerary.title: Luxor Temples & Flight to Cairo
itinerary.text:
Breakfast on board the cruise followed by disembarkation from your Nile River cruise ship.
Visit the magnificent Luxor Temple and explore the Karnak Temple Complex dedicated to the god Amun.
After free time at leisure, transfer to Luxor International Airport for your flight to Cairo.
Upon arrival, meet and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: G. Egyptian Museum, Old Cairo & Khan El-Khalili
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit the Grand Egyptian Museum before continuing to the historic Cairo Citadel and the beautiful Mosque of Muhammad Ali. Explore Old Cairo and visit the Saints Sergius and Bacchus Church and the Hanging Church. Later, enjoy free time at the famous Khan el-Khalili bazaar before returning to the hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Alexandria
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Drive to Alexandria and visit the famous Bibliotheca Alexandrina. Explore the ancient Roman Amphitheatre of Alexandria, visit Pompey's Pillar, and view the historic Citadel of Qaitbay from outside. Return to Cairo in the evening. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Departure from Cairo
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Cairo Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 10-Day Egypt Cultural Tour & Nile Cruise?
faqs.a: The 10-Day Egypt Cultural Tour & Nile Cruise covers Cairo, Alexandria, Luxor, and Aswan, along with a 3-night Nile Cruise. You will explore Egypt's ancient wonders, discover the Mediterranean charm of Alexandria, visit the magnificent temples and tombs of Luxor, and experience the beauty of Aswan while cruising along the Nile River. The tour runs for 9 nights and 10 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 10-Day Egypt Cultural Tour & Nile Cruise cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,995 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes hotel accommodation, a 3-night Nile Cruise, two domestic flights, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees according to the itinerary, selected meals, and all airport, hotel, and cruise transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and accommodation category.

faqs.q: Are domestic flights included in the package?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes two domestic flights within Egypt. These flights help reduce travel time between Cairo and Upper Egypt, allowing you to spend more time exploring the country's famous attractions.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels in Cairo and Alexandria, as well as a 3-night Nile Cruise between Luxor and Aswan. Daily breakfast is included at hotels, while meals onboard the cruise are provided according to the cruise itinerary.

faqs.q: Does the 10-day Egypt tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking Egyptologist guides accompany all scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guide will provide detailed explanations of Egypt's fascinating history, archaeology, and cultural heritage.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Egypt?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who want a comprehensive overview of Egypt. It combines ancient monuments, Mediterranean culture, Nile cruising, and some of the country's most important historical sites in a single itinerary.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, temples, museums, and cruise ports. Most visitors with average fitness levels can comfortably participate throughout the journey.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Cairo, Alexandria, Luxor, Aswan, and the Nile Cruise?
faqs.a: Cairo is famous for the Pyramids of Giza, the Great Sphinx, and the Egyptian Museum. Alexandria offers attractions such as the Catacombs, Qaitbay Citadel, and the modern Bibliotheca Alexandrina. Luxor features Karnak Temple, Luxor Temple, and the Valley of the Kings. Aswan is known for the Philae Temple and Nubian culture, while the Nile Cruise provides unforgettable scenery and visits to remarkable ancient temples along the river.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 10-Day Egypt Cultural Tour & Nile Cruise?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 90 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 90 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, cruise conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 10-Day Egypt Cultural Tour & Nile Cruise be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add Abu Simbel, extend your stay in Cairo or Alexandria, upgrade hotel or cruise categories, include a Red Sea extension, or modify the itinerary. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
